channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Steven Adams | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Steven Adams from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Karl-Anthony Towns on Blake Griffin, DeMarcus Cousins, DeAndre Jordan, Steven Adams, Mitchell Robinson
item.description:
Karl-Anthony Towns:

“I would say the person that's toughest is probably going to be like DeMarcus Cousins or Steven Adams. I've probably in my life ever had to tag the roller. During defense, you're on the other side and you come over to tag the roller to hold him up so he doesn't DeAndre Jordan, alley-oop dunk, Blake Griffin, alley-oop dunk like that, Mitchell Robinson, alley-oop dunk. You try to slow down the roller so it makes it easier to deal with the pick and roll, the player, two offensive players and the two defensive players. It makes it easier and gives them more time to figure out the situation with the PNR.”

Karl-Anthony Towns on Blake Griffin, DeMarcus Cousins, DeAndre Jordan, Steven Adams, Mitchell Robinson, Oct 17, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Kevin Durant on Steven Adams, Fred VanVleet
item.description:
Kevin Durant:

“It's growing every day. I feel like we can be even closer as a coach-player. Somebody that I always can lean on throughout a game and vice versa. We need to continue to keep building that. Also having Fred (VanVleet) and Steven (Adams) back is going to be good for all of us, being in these leadership positions and having younger guys on the team that look up to us. It's a group effort in everything we do, leadership, scoring, defending, everything is a group effort.”

Kevin Durant on Steven Adams, Fred VanVleet, Sep 24, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Fred VanVleet on Steven Adams, Reed Sheppard
item.description:
“He's going to be better than Reed Sheppard was last year. Not that Sheppard was that bad, but, Fred's a better creator. He's a better paint threat guy off the dribble. He may not be a better catch-and-shoot three-point shooter, but he's more adept at getting it off in the pick-and-roll. So they have a couple guys that can set screens, especially if Steven Adams is healthy. So I think he'll be a weapon for them that they didn't have.”

Fred VanVleet on Steven Adams, Reed Sheppard, Sep 18, 2026. Source: Sports Illustrated.

item.title: Collin Murray-Boyles on Steven Adams
item.description:
Raptors rookie Collin Murray-Boyles on batting with Steven Adams tonight:

“He’s insanely strong. My wrists are sore right now, trying to box him out and tussle with him. His strength is, I didn’t think it was like that. I was asking him what his routine is mid-game. It’s insane.”

Collin Murray-Boyles on Steven Adams, Oct 29, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Alperen Sengun on Jabari Smith, Steven Adams
item.description:
Alperen Şengün on Steven Adams:

“Steven was really effective in the Zone. He talks a lot. He knows where to stand and directs me and Jabari a lot”

Alperen Sengun on Jabari Smith, Steven Adams, Aug 17, 2025. Source: reddit.

item.title: Draymond Green on Steven Adams
item.description:
Draymond Green on Steven Adams:

“He's having a great impact, doing a great job on the offensive glass, defensively. I just wish we could get a 3 second call. He's standing in the paint the whole possession, it's hard to box out, he's strong as hell. Being outweighed by what 40-50 pounds, 6 inches—”

Draymond Green on Steven Adams, May 3, 2025. Source: reddit.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Draymond Green, Steven Adams
item.description:
Steve Kerr on Draymond Green's mention of no three-second calls on Steven Adams:

“We thought there were three or four of them last night. But it's not really a call officials make very often. So we can't worry about it too much.”

Steve Kerr on Draymond Green, Steven Adams, May 3, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Jimmy Butler on Steven Adams
item.description:
Jimmy Butler:

“I saw that I wasn't battling with Steven Adams on the last play, so I was able to go up there and be a semi-athlete. I wanted that rebound. I told Dray, 'If you get a stop, I will get the rebound,' and he got the stop, and I got the rebound.”

Jimmy Butler on Steven Adams, Apr 29, 2025. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Bradley Beal on Mason Plumlee, Steven Adams
item.description:
Beal on Plumlee and Adams being ejected after tussle:

“I think they both should've stayed in the game. They just got tussled up, caught up. Nobody threw any blows. Big dog tried to pick Mason up. Mason wasn't going for it. They just went to the floor. Two techs, let keep it moving.”

Bradley Beal on Mason Plumlee, Steven Adams, Mar 13, 2025. Source: Arizona Republic.

item.title: Devin Booker on Steven Adams
item.description:
“Nah. Obviously I'm biased, but I feel like Steven tried to pick him up and slam him and Mason happened to just be on top of him.”

Devin Booker on Steven Adams, Mar 13, 2025. Source: Twitter @DuaneRankin.

item.title: Mason Plumlee on Steven Adams
item.description:
Plumlee on his tussle, takedown with Adams:

“He goes for every rebound and he does it whether it's dirty or not. I just felt like they were being more physical than us. I just made a point to hit him on the glass.”

Mason Plumlee on Steven Adams, Mar 13, 2025. Source: Arizona Republic.

item.title: Zach Edey on Kevin Durant, Steven Adams
item.description:
“I’m never going to be the wiry seven-foot guy who can — like Kevin Durant, that is never going to be me, guys like that. I’m a 7-foot-4, 300-pound guy. I’m built to be in the paint, to carve out space to protect my area. And that’s what I’m gonna keep doing. I think there’s a lot of people in the NBA that do stuff like that. (Jonas) Valančiūnas, (Ivica) Zubac, Steven Adams; guys who had a lot of success in the NBA being those paint presences. I’m going to stick to who I am and I kind of know who I am.”

Zach Edey on Kevin Durant, Steven Adams, May 16, 2024. Source: New York Times.

item.title: Taylor Jenkins on Steven Adams
item.description:
Drew Hill:Taylor Jenkins on status of Steven Adams:

“Steve-O is getting back, hopefully in the next week or two,he’s starting to do more on the court. Follow ups with the doctors have gone well but we don’t have an update on the timeline other than what we initially put out.”

Taylor Jenkins on Steven Adams, Feb 14, 2023. Source: Twitter @DrewHill_DM.

item.title: Jaren Jackson Jr on Steven Adams
item.description:
Drew Hill:Jaren Jackson Jr. on Steven Adams:

“He’s the best screener in NBA history and probably the best offensive rebounder ever. When you do those things, it just saves us time and time again.”

Jaren Jackson Jr on Steven Adams, Jan 19, 2023. Source: Twitter @DrewHill_DM.

item.title: Ja Morant on Steven Adams
item.description:
Ja Morant on Steven Adams w/@GrizzOnBally:

“I feel like a lot of stuff he does for us goes unnoticed and it’s time for people to start watching.”

Ja Morant on Steven Adams, Jan 2, 2023. Source: Twitter @DrewHill_DM.

item.title: Mike Brown on Steven Adams
item.description:
Kings coach Mike Brown said.

“He’s a grown man, and I felt there were too many times when we didn’t gang rebound. Not many people in the league — I can’t even think of anybody right now — can box him out one-on-one. So, you have to have a guy in front of him, and you have to have a guy behind him to gang rebound and try to keep them off the glass and hope your teammates come up with the ball. Again, I thought too many times we didn’t go box out our guy, nor did we go try to help dome us with Steven Adams, and he came up with big rebounds for them.”

Mike Brown on Steven Adams, Jan 2, 2023. Source: Sacramento Bee.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Steven Adams
item.description:
Damichael Cole:Steve Kerr on Steven Adams being back and preparing for him:

“It’s been a topic of discussion in our coaches meetings. If they start him, we’ve planned for that.”

Steve Kerr on Steven Adams, May 7, 2022. Source: Twitter @DamichaelC.

item.title: Quin Snyder on Steven Adams
item.description:
Damichael Cole:Quin Snyder on Steven Adams:

“I have a lot of love for Steven Adams and have for a while. He’s like a middle linebacker that leads the defense and communicates.”

Quin Snyder on Steven Adams, Jan 28, 2022. Source: Twitter @DamichaelC.

item.title: Desmond Bane on Steven Adams, Tony Bradley
item.description:
Damichael Cole:Desmond Bane on his viewpoint of Steven Adams carrying Tony Bradley:

“When I looked up on the Jumbotron and saw his feet hovering the ground and (Steven) carrying him like he a lil kid, I couldn’t help but laugh.”

Desmond Bane on Steven Adams, Tony Bradley, Jan 17, 2022. Source: Twitter @DamichaelC.

item.title: Stan Van Gundy on Steven Adams, Nikola Jokic
item.description:
Eliot Clough:Stan Van Gundy on Steven Adams guarding Jokic:

“He was tremendous. Some of the buckets he gave up were on our scheme or on me. Steven had a lot of really long closeouts. ... His rebounding kept us alive in the first half. He was absolutely key to our victory.”

Stan Van Gundy on Steven Adams, Nikola Jokic, Mar 21, 2021. Source: Twitter @EliotClough.

item.title: Stan Van Gundy on Steven Adams, Eric Bledsoe
item.description:
Jim Eichenhofer:Stan Van Gundy on Adams/Bledsoe adding intensity:

“They're going to compete every single night. Our veteran guys are really highly competitive guys. You can put JJ in there (too). Those guys will get on the floor (for loose balls). Steven and Bled have brought that to our team.”

Stan Van Gundy on Steven Adams, Eric Bledsoe, Dec 19, 2020. Source: Twitter @Jim_Eichenhofer.

item.title: Sam Presti on Steven Adams
item.description:
Presti on the Steven Adams trade:

“That was a difficult decision to make. I talked with Steven prior, I extended my gratitude to him. He's left a tremendous mark on our franchise. Ultimately we have to put the Thunder first. It wasn't my best day at work, I'll tell you that.”

Sam Presti on Steven Adams, Nov 30, 2020. Source: Twitter @BrandonRahbar.

item.title: Billy Donovan on Steven Adams
item.description:
Brandon Rahbar:Billy Donovan:

“I said from the beginning of the series Steven is an important piece of our team.”

Billy Donovan on Steven Adams, Aug 30, 2020. Source: Twitter @BrandonRahbar.

item.title: Gregg Popovich on Steven Adams
item.description:
Maddie Lee:Gregg Popovich on Steven Adams:

“When I do see him, he scares me. He’s one tough dude.”

Gregg Popovich on Steven Adams, Jan 10, 2019. Source: Twitter @maddie_m_lee.

item.title: Doc Rivers on Steven Adams
item.description:
Brett Dawson:Doc Rivers on Steven Adams:

“He’s proof that you don’t need to talk the game. You can just BE tough.”

Doc Rivers on Steven Adams, Dec 15, 2018. Source: Twitter @BDawsonWrites.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Steven Adams
item.description:
Carlisle on OKC center Steven Adams:

“He's a force. Much improved offensively. Gets better each year on the block, around the paint. He's a great system player for them. His ability to secure the ball and get them extra possessions is a big part of their success.”

Rick Carlisle on Steven Adams, Nov 10, 2018. Source: Twitter @DwainPrice.

item.title: Paul George on Billy Donovan, Andre Roberson, Steven Adams
item.description:
“But being around Sam, being around Russ, being around [coach] Billy [Donovan], Dre [Andre Roberson], Steven [Adams], I gained a brotherhood. [Giving that group only] one year just didn’t sit well with me. I went to war, I went to battle, we made the playoffs, we were in the hunt, and we stuck together all year long. You never heard of any turmoil, no matter how we played, in the locker room. We built a real brotherhood there and I didn’t want to walk away from that.”

Paul George on Billy Donovan, Andre Roberson, Steven Adams, Jul 26, 2018. Source: Oklahoman.

item.title: Russell Westbrook on Steven Adams
item.description:
Russell Westbrook on Steven Adams' growth:

“He constantly comes back better and better. He’s probably one of the most feared big men in the league because of his size … how he looks.”

Russell Westbrook on Steven Adams, Apr 28, 2018. Source: Twitter @ErikHorneOK.

item.title: Paul George on Steven Adams
item.description:
Paul George on what surprised him about Steven Adams after he met him:

“Going against him, I thought he was some cocky arrogant dude, who always just wanted to start trouble...and when I got here, it was the truth.”

Paul George on Steven Adams, Mar 27, 2018. Source: Twitter @FredKatz.

item.title: Jimmy Butler on Steven Adams
item.description:
Butler heard him and replied,

“I just had to chase Russ (Westbrook) around and get hit by Steven Adams. I can listen to whatever (expletive) music I want.”

Jimmy Butler on Steven Adams, Jan 11, 2018. Source: USA Today Sports.
